skills.name: HOLE_UP
skills.when: night and candig and not sword
skills.reason: starter: dig two down, put the block that came out in hand, cap the hole, wait for day

skills.name: TOWER
skills.when: night and hostiles > 0 and blocks >= 3 and roomabove
skills.reason: starter: three blocks under the feet and stay up there until day

skills.name: WALL_OFF
skills.when: hostiles > 0 and nearest != FAR and blocks >= 2
skills.reason: starter: two blocks between the body and the nearest hostile

skills.name: DAYLIGHT
skills.when: cover != SKY and stuck and blocks > 0
skills.reason: starter: break the ceiling and stack up until the sky is back overhead

skills.name: FIGHT
skills.reason: starter: with a sword in hand, fight the most dangerous hostile first

skills.name: RETREAT
skills.reason: starter: run from the nearest hostile for five seconds

skills.name: TABLE_STONE_PICKAXE
skills.when: has(crafting_table) > 0 and has(COBBLESTONE) >= 3 and has(STICK) >= 2 and short(STONE_PICKAXE) > 0 and menu == NONE
skills.reason: starter: set the table down, craft the stone pickaxe on it, then pick the table up again

skills.name: FURNACE_IRON
skills.when: has(furnace) > 0 and has(RAW_IRON) > 0 and has(COAL) > 0 and pickaxe and menu == NONE
skills.reason: starter: set the furnace down, load it, wait, take the ingots, then pick the furnace up again
